methods.name: initialize
methods.docs:
Initializes the Facebook JavaScript SDK on Web.
This is a no-op on Android and iOS, where the SDK is configured natively.

parameters.name: options
parameters.type: { permissions: string[]; tracking?: 'limited' | 'enabled' | undefined; nonce?: string | undefined; }

methods.docs:
Starts the Facebook login flow with the requested permissions.
A cancelled native login resolves without a token.

methods.name: logout

methods.name: setAutoLogAppEventsEnabled
methods.docs: Enables or disables automatic App Event logging on native platforms.

methods.name: setAdvertiserTrackingEnabled
methods.docs: Enables or disables advertiser tracking on iOS.

methods.name: setAdvertiserIDCollectionEnabled
methods.docs: Enables or disables advertiser ID collection on native platforms.

methods.name: getDeferredDeepLink
methods.docs:
Fetches the deferred App Link attributed to this app install.
Native platforms resolve without a URI when no link is available. Web
always resolves without a URI.

properties.name: autoLogAppEvents
properties.docs: Whether the Web SDK automatically logs App Events.

properties.name: xfbml
properties.docs: Whether the Web SDK parses XFBML social plugins.

properties.name: version
properties.docs: Facebook Graph API version used by the Web SDK. Defaults to `v26.0`.

properties.name: locale
properties.docs: Locale used to load the Web SDK. Defaults to `en_US`.

properties.name: accessToken
properties.docs: Token response when one is returned by the platform.

properties.name: applicationId
properties.docs: Meta application ID that issued the token.

properties.name: lastRefresh
properties.docs: ISO 8601 date when the token was last refreshed.

properties.name: token
properties.docs:
Token string returned by the platform. With iOS Limited Login, this is an
OIDC authentication token (JWT), not a Graph API access token.

properties.name: userId
properties.docs: Facebook user ID associated with the token.

properties.name: accessToken
properties.docs: Current token response when one is returned by the platform.

properties.name: uri
properties.docs: Deferred App Link URI. Omitted when Meta has no link for this install.
